note: Jenkins County GA publishes its parcel map only through the qPublic/Schneider viewer (qpublic.net/ga/jenkins), which is not a public ArcGIS REST service and returned HTTP 403 to automated reads. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Jenkins County parcels returned no FeatureServer/MapServer parcel layer. The county site, tax commissioner site and Georgia GIO hub link no downloadable parcel layer. Regrid is commercial and not a county source.
